purpose: Manual cluster decisions for query-expansion map (Mark pilot). Update as each cluster is reviewed.

extraction_notes.hapax_blind_spot: Confirmed: candidates have zero freq==1 lemmas (min=2). Example: neverstvo at Mk 6:6 appears once in DK lemmatized CSV, absent from all 1020 candidates. Not a one-off — every hapax in Mark is invisible to this pilot.
extraction_notes.scaling_rule: When scaling beyond Mark to full NZ: use freq≥1 for abstract nouns/verbs (theological terms), OR emit a separate hapax review list of cut lemmas. Otherwise book-hapaxes that are significant across the Testament (opravdanje, osvećenje, pomirenje — often once per epistle) will silently drop out of 27 books.
extraction_notes.noun_verb_partner_check: THIRD recurring miss pattern (#4 oproštenje, #6 nauka, #11 zapovest): verb-only clusters omit the noun users actually type — and that noun↔verb gap is the measured semantic hole. Scaling rule: when a cluster contains only verbs, automatically check for a noun partner (and vice versa) before locking. Do not trust join_basis=shared_root/aspect alone.

lemma_channel_noise_aorist.pattern: Archaic aorist/surface forms of one verb lemmatized as a shorter unrelated (or related-looking) lemma → lemma-search returns false hits.
lemma_channel_noise_aorist.why_it_matters: Same archaic morphology that Embedić handles weakly also confuses CLASSLA. When a suspicious lemma hit appears, check whether the surface is an aorist/form of a different verb (postati, etc.) before trusting the lemma label.
examples: DK 'поста' (aorist of postati) → lemma post (fasting). #13. Live lemma-search noise.
Candidate 'upit' (POS=glagol, forms=['упита']) = aorist of upitati, not noun упит. #15.
Candidate 'povik' (POS=glagol, forms=['повика']) = aorist of povikati. #17. Also 'povika' labeled imenica at Mk 1:23 — surface is still verb 'и повика'.
lemma_channel_noise_aorist.reliability_note: Three confirmed Mark cases = enough to treat as a known CLASSLA noise class for this corpus (aorist/surface → shorter wrong lemma). Still verify case-by-case when suspected — not an auto-fix rule. Does not claim every aorist fails; claims the failure mode is real and recurring.

expansion_shape_rules.rule: Za polisemične/kratke leme mapa širi ka frazama i oblicima sa kontekstom, ne ka golim lemama.
evidence: #10 пуст: 'пусто мјесто' → Mark top ok (6:32/6:35); goli 'пуст' prljavije; idiom 'пусте жеље' cos 0.77 > 'пустиња' 0.74 (mešanje u query-prostoru).
#7 кратка forma: golo 'моли' → rank 1000+ (мољци/милујте) — kontekst/dužina čisti vektor; mehanizam ovde je homograf/morfologija, ne polisemija prideva (vidi SHAPE-2 za refleksiv).
expansion_shape_rules.mechanisms_note: Ista posledica (kontekst čisti vektor), možda dva odvojena pravila kad bude više primera — ne spajati u 'zakon' još. Dva primera nisu dovoljna za potvrdu.

expansion_shape_rules.rule: Refleksiv i/ili svršeni vid kao razlikovni signal kad glagol ima dva odsjaja — ne o dužini upita nego o gramatičkoj kategoriji koja nosi značenje.
evidence: #7 молити: 'молити се' / помолити се = molitva Bogu; golo молити često = preklinjanje čoveka (~50/50 u Marku). Mapa za upit 'молитва' preferira refleksiv/svršeni, ne sve forme молити.
expansion_shape_rules.mechanisms_note: Jedan jasan primer — treba još (кајати се, обратити се, поклонити се) pre nego što postane pravilo mape.

Thematic in Mark: Jovan 1:3–4; Isus temptation 1:12–13; пусто мјесто prayer/withdrawal 1:35 (SPC; DK may paraphrase), 6:32/35; feeding 8:4 'у пустињи'. pust adj (freq 6) = пусто/пустијем мјесто ONLY — no figurative 'пусте жеље/сни' in Mark.
